questions.q: What does Parkinson's Law in its best-known sense say?
options: Work expands to fill the time available
questions.explain: The commonly used personal version is that work expands to fill the time available.

questions.q: Where was Parkinson's essay first published?
questions.explain: It was published in The Economist in 1955.

questions.q: Which two forces did Parkinson give to explain bureaucratic staff growth?
options: Officials want to multiply subordinates; officials make work for each other
Officials want to multiply rivals; officials reduce work for each other
Officials avoid promoting subordinates; officials streamline each other's tasks
Officials seek fewer subordinates; officials centralize work to reduce jobs
questions.explain: He explained growth by (1) officials wanting to multiply subordinates and (2) officials making work for each other.

questions.q: What minimal size of a state's most powerful body did Parkinson note most often?
questions.explain: Parkinson noted that the minimal size was most often five members.

questions.q: What does the Admiralty and Colonial Office example imply?
options: The two offices merged early to reduce staff costs
Staff shrank in proportion to the fall in colonies
Staff grew even as ships and colonies declined
Work grew with the empire, so staff grew too
questions.explain: Their staff grew even though ships and colonies were declining, showing growth independent of work.
